description: This PHP class 'ParamRuleCollection' manages a collection of parameter validation rules, including adding, removing, and retrieving validation rules, as well as handling exclusion keys and strict mode settings.

classes.name: ParamRuleCollection
classes.description: A collection class for managing parameter validation rules, supporting addition, removal, validation, and configuration of rules.

methods.name: getParamValidations
methods.description: Returns all parameter validation rules as an indexed array.

methods.name: setParamValidations
methods.description: Replaces current validation rules with the provided array of ParamRule objects.

methods.name: addParamValidation
methods.description: Adds a ParamRule to the collection; throws an exception if a rule for the same parameter key already exists.

methods.name: removeParamValidation
methods.description: Removes and returns the ParamRule associated with the given parameter key, or null if not found.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Returns whether strict validation mode is enabled.

methods.name: setStrict
methods.description: Sets whether strict validation mode is enabled.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of parameter validation rules.

methods.name: getExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter keys excluded from validation.

methods.name: setExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Sets the list of parameter keys to be excluded from validation.

methods.name: addExcludedParamKey
methods.description: Adds a single parameter key to the exclusion list.
